title: solutions-pro-services-weekly-sync-notes-2026-08-04
content:
Solutions + Pro Services Weekly Sync — 2026-08-04
Attendees: Priya Nair (owner), Diego Martinez, Ava Thompson, Michael Chen, Sofia Alvarez, Jonathan Lee (sales), Claire Park (SRE, part-time)
Notes taker: Priya
Duration: 30m

Agenda:
- Quick round-robin: customer status highlights
- Blockers & escalations
- Priority actions for the week
- Ops/infra notes that affect integrations

1) Acme Payments (onboarding for checkout assistant)
- Status: staging infra validated; smoke tests passing for basic flows (tokenize, generate receipts).
- Recent work: integrated prefix caching and reduced tail latency by ~12% on 1k token test set.
- Blockers: PCI review still outstanding — security team requested additional KMS audit logs. Ticket RD-3421 created.
- Risk: If PCI signoff delayed >2 weeks, go-live slips.
- Action items:
  - Diego to provide audit log export examples to Acme security by 2026-08-06 (RD-3421).
  - Priya to schedule 30-min deep dive with Redwood Security and Acme compliance on 2026-08-05.
  - Sales (Jonathan) to align go-live expectations with customer by EOD 2026-08-06.

2) MediBank (private deployment / VPC)
- Status: deployment package delivered; customer is finishing internal networking config.
- Recent work: private control plane install guide updated with explicit enclave KMS steps.
- Blockers: Customer hit an issue with NAT gateway egress rules causing package download failures.
- Action items:
  - Ava to send patched bootstrap script (v1.0.3) and verify checksums by 2026-08-05.
  - MediBank infra lead to confirm proxy allowlist by 2026-08-06.
  - Diego to standby for remote pairing 2026-08-07 if issues persist.

3) Shoply (hosted API integration for product search reranking)
- Status: alpha integration in prod; running at 10% traffic for A/B experiment. Latency SLOs mostly met; occasional 95th p95 spikes during peak.
- Recent work: applied adaptive batching suggestion from Redwood Optimize; reduced cost per 1K requests by ~8%.
- Blockers: Observed occasional tokenization mismatch when customers send mixed encodings — causes rerank divergence.
- Action items:
  - Michael to prepare a small repro and file RD-3498 with sample payloads by 2026-08-05.
  - Product to propose a schema validation layer for incoming requests (Priya + Product) — propose quick spec by 2026-08-10.

4) EduLabs (proof-of-concept, embeddings + semantic search)
- Status: demo completed; customer requested multi-language support and tighter vector dimension controls.
- Recent work: Prototype quantized embedding vector option tested internally — accuracy drop acceptable for some use cases.
- Blockers: Need legal approval for cross-region data residency before multi-region dataset indexing.
- Action items:
  - Sofia to draft a short note on accuracy tradeoffs for quantized embeddings (due 2026-08-07).
  - Claire to confirm data residency options available and any billing implications by 2026-08-09.

Cross-cutting items / Ops notes:
- Runtime upgrade scheduled next Tuesday (2026-08-11) to roll kernel-level improvements; will require short rolling restarts in Dedicated clusters. Notify customers with Dedicated instances. Priya to draft customer-facing notice by 2026-08-06.
- Observability: Per-route tracing work is behind — ETA moved to 2026-08-18. This impacts deeper troubleshooting for Shoply spikes. Michael to keep a running list of incidents that need tracing to prioritize work.
- Canary/fallback policy: propose enabling automatic fallback to smaller model variant for non-critical endpoints to reduce user impact during upgrades. Discuss in product sync next week.

Open blockers summary (priority order):
- RD-3421 (Acme PCI KMS audit logs) — high — owner Diego — due 2026-08-06
- RD-3498 (Shoply tokenization repro) — medium — owner Michael — due 2026-08-05
- Private deploy NAT issue (MediBank) — high — owner Ava — bootstrap patch 2026-08-05

Action item tracker (quick):
- Priya: schedule Acme compliance deep dive (2026-08-05); draft runtime upgrade customer notice (2026-08-06).
- Diego: deliver audit export examples to Acme (2026-08-06); standby pairing for MediBank if needed (2026-08-07).
- Ava: patch bootstrap script v1.0.3 and send by 2026-08-05.
- Michael: file RD-3498 with repro payloads (2026-08-05); collate incidents affected by missing tracing.
- Sofia: draft quantized embedding note (2026-08-07).
- Claire: confirm data residency paths and billing impacts (2026-08-09).

Other notes / capture of quick ideas:
- Consider a short "preflight" checklist for Private installs that explicitly lists NAT/proxy/egress checks to avoid this week's MediBank pauses. Could be a small doc in Confluence (CONF-ps-integration-runbook).
- Raise a small internal RFC for a lightweight request-schema validation proxy for hosted API customers (low-effort, high-impact). Priya to scope.

Next meeting: 2026-08-11 (same time) — will shift focus to runtime upgrade impacts and any go-live date confirmations.

End of notes.
